title: Output and cost of the restricted weight program
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, and let the input specify positive integers $a,d$ with $2a\le d$ and an integer Fourier bound $s\ge1$. Let $J$ be any set of coordinates in the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $S\subseteq J$, and let $f$ be a Boolean function on that cube. Running the deterministic restricted weight program with oracle $f$ returns the restricted Fourier weight estimate for $f$ on $J,S$, together with a cost whose random-example count is zero, whose membership-query count is the program's prescribed query count, and whose work is the sum of its construction and local-work charges.
